description:
A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness.

DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.
- The desktop app and its downloads are now named DS Bot. Existing teams, settings and browser data carry over.
- Group chats: no limit on how often Bots call each other; members called in one message start at the same time; the calling Bot is woken once after the last of them finishes.
- Bots no longer start subagents or workflows from DeepSeek Harness; they hand work to other Bots. A message you steer into a running turn in a Bot's private chat reaches the Bot at once.
- The Linux desktop app no longer crashes when it reads images.
- Safer data: Bot-to-Bot messages are no longer lost on restart or failed delivery; outside edits to the team's state file are no longer overwritten; Bots cannot reach data folders inside a team workspace; secrets stay available after a restart.
- 30 more fixes across group chats, memory, voice input, usage, the sidebar and the macOS window header.
Full list: CHANGELOG.
